'''August 2001 Billings tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Splash Page, Billings, MT on 11 August 2001. [[Travis Rumans]] won it. It is known from Travis Rumans's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2827">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-08-12-billings-mt-8-11-01-finally-a-foild2827/ billings-mt-8-11-01-finally-a-foil], DeckTech (Travis "Com Igar" Rumans, 12 August 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-08-12-billings-mt-8-11-01-finally-a-foild2827/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 11 August 2001
* '''Site:''' Splash Page, Billings, MT
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Coruscant]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Travis Rumans]]
